label: twinvee-escrow
description: Derived from the public Twin Vee second amendment (SEC EDGAR Exhibit 10.1, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1855509/000173112226001331/e8000_ex10-1.htm), §3(a)–(b): a $150,000 escrow funded at signing, $75,000 released on 2027-01-02, and three conditional $25,000 releases (2027-01-02, 2027-02-02, 2027-03-02) that each require a monthly extension to be granted. The base $6k/month retainer and the first-amendment payments are deliberately excluded pending sourced human interpretation (milestone 3). The contractual release date 2027-01-02 is a Saturday and is modeled as received 2027-01-04 under the weekend rule (Saturday/Sunday receipts roll to the next Monday; escrow deposits and costs never move). Scenario no_extensions grants none of the extensions; all_extensions grants all three. Escrow is not cash: the $15M deposit does not touch the cash balance, so the firm breaches its floor while the escrow sits funded.

demoAssumptions.note: Demo assumptions, not facts about the parties
